title.de: Fragen und Verneinung in der Vergangenheit: did, didn't
title.sl: Vprašanja in zanikanje v pretekliku: did, didn't
title.it: Domande e negazione al passato: did, didn't

goal.sl: Vprašaš in zanikaš v pretekliku (Did you go? I didn't go.), odgovoriš na kratko (Yes, I did. No, I didn't.) in vprašaš Where did you go?, What did you see?, Who saw it?
goal.de: Du fragst und verneinst in der Vergangenheit (Did you go? I didn't go.), antwortest kurz (Yes, I did. No, I didn't.) und fragst Where did you go?, What did you see?, Who saw it?
goal.it: Fai domande e dici di no al passato (Did you go? I didn't go.), rispondi in breve (Yes, I did. No, I didn't.) e chiedi Where did you go?, What did you see?, Who saw it?
goal.en: You can ask and say no in the past (Did you go? I didn't go.), answer short (Yes, I did. No, I didn't.) and ask Where did you go?, What did you see?, Who saw it?

say.sl: Za zanikanje v pretekliku vzameš **didn't** (did not: ne) z osnovno obliko, za vse osebe: **I didn't go.** ({m:Nisem šel|f:Nisem šla}.) **Jack didn't see the fox.** (Jack ni videl lisice.) Preteklik je že v **didn't**. Nikoli *I didn't went*, nikoli *Jack didn't saw*.
say.de: Zum Verneinen in der Vergangenheit nimmst du **didn't** (did not: nicht) mit der Grundform, für alle Personen: **I didn't go.** (Ich bin nicht gegangen.) **Jack didn't see the fox.** (Jack hat den Fuchs nicht gesehen.) Die Vergangenheit steckt schon in **didn't**. Nie *I didn't went*, nie *Jack didn't saw*.
say.it: Per dire di no al passato usi **didn't** (did not: non) con la forma base, per tutte le persone: **I didn't go.** (Non ci sono andat{m:o|f:a}.) **Jack didn't see the fox.** (Jack non ha visto la volpe.) Il passato è già in **didn't**. Mai *I didn't went*, mai *Jack didn't saw*.
say.en: For no in the past, use **didn't** (did not) + the base form, for every person: **I didn't go** (never *I didn't went*). **Jack didn't see the fox** (never *Jack didn't saw*). **didn't** already says it's the past.

examples.en: I didn't go to the market.
examples.de: Ich bin nicht auf den Markt gegangen.
Jack hat den Fuchs nicht gesehen.
examples.it: Jack non ha visto la volpe.

examples.en: The bus didn't come this morning.
examples.de: Der Bus ist heute Morgen nicht gekommen.

say.sl: Enako pri glagolih na -ed: walked → **didn't walk**, rained → **didn't rain**, stopped → **didn't stop**, had → **didn't have**. Končnica **-ed** odpade. Nikoli *didn't walked*: **We didn't stop at the inn.** (Nismo se ustavili v gostilni.)
say.de: Genauso bei den Verben auf -ed: walked → **didn't walk**, rained → **didn't rain**, stopped → **didn't stop**, had → **didn't have**. Das **-ed** fällt weg. Nie *didn't walked*: **We didn't stop at the inn.** (Wir haben beim Gasthaus nicht angehalten.)
say.it: Lo stesso con i verbi in -ed: walked → **didn't walk**, rained → **didn't rain**, stopped → **didn't stop**, had → **didn't have**. La **-ed** cade. Mai *didn't walked*: **We didn't stop at the inn.** (Non ci siamo fermati alla locanda.)
say.en: The same with verbs in -ed: walked → **didn't walk** (never *didn't walked*), rained → **didn't rain**, stopped → **didn't stop**, had → **didn't have**. The **-ed** goes: **We didn't stop at the inn.**

examples.it: La signora Birkett non ha avuto tempo.

examples.en: We didn't stop at the inn.
examples.de: Wir haben beim Gasthaus nicht angehalten.
examples.it: Non ci siamo fermati alla locanda.

say.sl: Za vprašanje gre **Did** na začetek, glagol v osnovni obliki: **Did you see the fox?** (Si {m:videl|f:videla} lisico?) Nikoli *Did you saw?* Kratek odgovor ponovi did: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.**
say.de: Für die Frage kommt **Did** nach vorn, das Verb steht in der Grundform: **Did you see the fox?** (Hast du den Fuchs gesehen?) Nie *Did you saw?* Die Kurzantwort wiederholt did: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.**
say.it: Per la domanda **Did** va all'inizio, il verbo è alla forma base: **Did you see the fox?** (Hai visto la volpe?) Mai *Did you saw?* La risposta breve ripete did: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.**
say.en: To ask, **Did** goes first and the verb stays in the base form: **Did you see the fox?** (never *Did you saw?*) The short answer repeats did: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.**

say.sl: Vprašalnica je na začetku, za njo enak red: **Where did you go?** (Kam si {m:šel|f:šla}?) **What did you see?** (Kaj si {m:videl|f:videla}?) **When did the bus leave?** (Kdaj je odpeljal avtobus?) Nikoli *Where you went?*, nikoli *Where did you went?*
say.de: Das Fragewort steht vorn, danach dieselbe Reihenfolge: **Where did you go?** (Wohin bist du gegangen?) **What did you see?** (Was hast du gesehen?) **When did the bus leave?** (Wann ist der Bus abgefahren?) Nie *Where you went?*, nie *Where did you went?*
say.it: La parola interrogativa va all'inizio, poi lo stesso ordine: **Where did you go?** (Dove sei andat{m:o|f:a}?) **What did you see?** (Che cosa hai visto?) **When did the bus leave?** (Quando è partito l'autobus?) Mai *Where you went?*, mai *Where did you went?*
say.en: The question word goes first, then the same order: **Where did you go?** (never *Where did you went?*) **What did you see?** **When did the bus leave?** Never *Where you went?*

examples.en: Where did you go last night?
examples.de: Wohin bist du gestern Abend gegangen?

say.sl: Kadar je **who** ali **what** osebek, did ni: **Who saw Jack?** (Kdo je videl Jacka?) **What happened?** (Kaj se je zgodilo?) Z osebkom pa je: **Who did Jack see?** (Koga je videl Jack?) Kratko: **Granny Maggie did.** Nikoli *Who did saw Jack?*
say.de: Ist **who** oder **what** das Subjekt, gibt es kein did: **Who saw Jack?** (Wer hat Jack gesehen?) **What happened?** (Was ist passiert?) Mit einem anderen Subjekt schon: **Who did Jack see?** (Wen hat Jack gesehen?) Kurz: **Granny Maggie did.** Nie *Who did saw Jack?*
say.it: Se **who** o **what** è il soggetto, niente did: **Who saw Jack?** (Chi ha visto Jack?) **What happened?** (Che cosa è successo?) Con un altro soggetto sì: **Who did Jack see?** (Jack chi ha visto?) In breve: **Granny Maggie did.** Mai *Who did saw Jack?*
say.en: When **who** or **what** is the subject, there is no did: **Who saw Jack?** **What happened?** With another subject there is: **Who did Jack see?** Short: **Granny Maggie did.** Never *Who did saw Jack?*

say.sl: **be** ne potrebuje did: **Were you at the inn?** (Si {m:bil|f:bila} v gostilni?) **It wasn't cold.** (Ni bilo mrzlo.) Za be vzameš was in were, za druge glagole did. **Were you tired?** **Did you walk home?** Nikoli *Did you were there?*, nikoli *It didn't was cold*.
say.de: **be** braucht kein did: **Were you at the inn?** (Warst du im Gasthaus?) **It wasn't cold.** (Es war nicht kalt.) Bei be nimmst du was und were, bei den anderen Verben did. **Were you tired?** **Did you walk home?** Nie *Did you were there?*, nie *It didn't was cold*.
say.it: **be** non vuole did: **Were you at the inn?** (Eri alla locanda?) **It wasn't cold.** (Non faceva freddo.) Con be usi was e were, con gli altri verbi did. **Were you tired?** **Did you walk home?** Mai *Did you were there?*, mai *It didn't was cold*.
say.en: **be** takes no did: **Were you at the inn?** **It wasn't cold.** Use was and were for be, did for other verbs. **Were you tired?** **Did you walk home?** Never *Did you were there?*, never *It didn't was cold*.

Did you walk home? — No, I didn't.

summary.sl: **Zanikanje: didn't + osnovna oblika: I didn't go.** Vprašanje: **Did you see the fox?** Odgovor: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.** Vprašalnica naprej: **Where did you go?** **What did you see?** Kadar je who osebek, did ni: **Who saw it?** **be** ne potrebuje did: **Were you there?** Nikoli *didn't went*, nikoli *Did you saw?*
summary.de: **Verneinung: didn't + Grundform: I didn't go.** Frage: **Did you see the fox?** Antwort: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.** Fragewort vorn: **Where did you go?** **What did you see?** Ist who das Subjekt, kein did: **Who saw it?** **be** braucht kein did: **Were you there?** Nie *didn't went*, nie *Did you saw?*
summary.it: **Negazione: didn't + forma base: I didn't go.** Domanda: **Did you see the fox?** Risposta: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.** Parola interrogativa all'inizio: **Where did you go?** **What did you see?** Se who è il soggetto, niente did: **Who saw it?** **be** non vuole did: **Were you there?** Mai *didn't went*, mai *Did you saw?*
summary.en: **No: didn't + the base form: I didn't go.** Question: **Did you see the fox?** Answer: **Yes, I did.** **No, I didn't.** Question word first: **Where did you go?** **What did you see?** When who is the subject, no did: **Who saw it?** **be** takes no did: **Were you there?** Never *didn't went*, never *Did you saw?*

translation.sl: — Si našel jagnje, Jack? — Ja. Bilo je za zidom. — Ti je Meg pomagala? — Ne. Ni marala dežja! — Pa tvoj klobuk? Kje si ga izgubil? — Kdo ga je zadnji videl? Gospa Birkett, mislim.
translation.de: — Hast du das Lamm gefunden, Jack? — Ja. Es war hinter der Mauer. — Hat dir Meg geholfen? — Nein. Sie hat den Regen nicht gemocht! — Und dein Hut? Wo hast du ihn verloren? — Wer hat ihn zuletzt gesehen? Mrs Birkett, glaube ich.
translation.it: — Hai trovato l'agnello, Jack? — Sì. Era dietro il muro. — Meg ti ha aiutato? — No. Non le piaceva la pioggia! — E il tuo cappello? Dove l'hai perso? — Chi l'ha visto per ultimo? La signora Birkett, credo.
translation.en: — Did you find the lamb, Jack? — Yes, I did. It was behind the wall. — Did Meg help you? — No, she didn't. She didn't like the rain! — And your hat? Where did you lose it? — Who saw it last? Mrs Birkett, I think.

translation.it: — Ha dormito bene, signora Hartley? — No. — Ha sentito il temporale? — Sì! Non ha smesso per tutta la notte. — Che cosa ha fatto? — Mi sono alzata e ho letto un libro.
translation.en: — Did you sleep well, Mrs Hartley? — No, I didn't. — Did you hear the storm? — Yes! It didn't stop all night. — What did you do? — I got up and read a book.
